commit_message: Integrate ADR0143 resource controls into current AI Studio
pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0143 model resource controls
pr_body:
## Summary

Integrates ADR0143 local model residency into current AI Studio while preserving ADR0145 external provider selection, provider-managed authentication, work claims, process cancellation, and AgentHost ownership. Interrupt-for-Editing releases supported local residency before Editor restoration; managed Play prioritizes renderer resources; Resume reloads only after authoritative-state re-inspection. Hosted/Enterprise backends keep local residency controls unavailable.

## Validation

Windows Validation: affected. Visual Validation is required for the AI Studio resource UI.
